title: COPD, high rate in VC: dynamic hyperinflation
summary: Rate 24 with a 4 s expiratory time constant: expiratory flow never reaches zero, end-expiratory alveolar pressure climbs well above the set PEEP of 0, and plateau pressure drifts up breath by breath.
objectives: Read auto-PEEP from the flow trace (non-zero end-expiratory flow) and confirm it with an expiratory hold.
Fix by lowering the rate and shortening Ti (higher flow) to lengthen Te.

fix.note: Rate 12, peak flow 80, Vt 450: Te triples and trapped volume falls.
